verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own CUDA documentation includes a guide for tuning CUDA kernels on Blackwell GPU architectures, and the DGX B300 docs identify the part as a Blackwell Ultra GPU that ships with NVIDIA's full software stack and DGX OS. That makes B300 a first-party CUDA target, though the link is through the architecture family rather than an explicit listing of the part. Missing for 10: an explicit CUDA supported-GPU or compute-capability listing naming B300/Blackwell Ultra, minimum CUDA toolkit/driver versions, and independent or hands-on confirmation of shipping CUDA workloads on B300.
